The interface ara::crypto::cryp::CryptoObject::Downcast shall cast the
provided generic CryptoObject to the derived object defined by the template Concre-
teObject and return a unique smart pointer to this derived object or kBadObjectType,
if the actual type of the provided crypto object does not match the specified Concre-
teObject.
